nodes.label: ManCharacter (Host / Friendly User Rig)
nodes.rationale: Foundational mascot rig (round glasses, swept black hair, blue tee, friendly round-oval face) cast as primary Host, beginner presenter, or curious everyday user.

nodes.label: Single React Component Rig Pattern
nodes.rationale: Drives expressions, poses, facing yaw, blinking, talking, and locomotion via React props on one SVG rig rather than static image swaps so visual identity stays identical across every episode.

nodes.label: Standard Character Props Interface
nodes.rationale: Exposes expression/pose blending, talking/mouth lip-sync, motion cycles, 3D yaw/head angles, pupil lookX/lookY, framing, and deterministic seed (prevents synchronized blinking/talking when multiple characters share a frame).

nodes.label: Rig Coordinate & Grounding System
nodes.rationale: Sets full framing to 840x900 px with feet at 95.6% height as default transform origin (so scale grows/shrinks from the shoes), 160 px head radius, ground at y=0, negative y upward, and [x, y, z] IK coordinates.

nodes.label: Lip-Sync & Auto Lip-Flap System
nodes.rationale: Supports quick ~0.1s automatic mouth cycling via talking prop as well as frame-accurate phoneme mouth shapes (rest, mbp, aa, ee, oh, oo, fv, l, etc) and expressive mouths via Studio keyframes.

nodes.label: Walk & Run Anti-Slide Calibration
nodes.rationale: Matches in-place walk/run cycles to horizontal style.translate speeds of ~150 px/s * speed * scale (walk) and 310 px/s (run) so feet do not visually slide across the floor.

nodes.label: FK/IK & Preset Customization
nodes.rationale: Enables custom PoseSpec via Forward Kinematics (lift, swing, bend, twist) or Inverse Kinematics (target, pole) and custom FaceSpec derived from EXPRESSIONS and POSES.

nodes.label: Interactive.create Studio Integration
nodes.rationale: Wraps character and property components with Interactive.create so props, placement, and keyframes can be manipulated visually inside Remotion Studio.

nodes.label: Mascot/MascotRig, RigDemo & ModelSheet Compositions
nodes.rationale: Provides interactive playground, 18s demo, and model-sheet render compositions; avoids naming any composition 'Character' to prevent Windows CLI path collision with the character/ folder.
